raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
**Purpose**
`draft_lm_head_quantization` gives the drafter an online-quantized copy of the target `lm_head` it shares. Until now only EAGLE and MTP could use it. This PR lets DFlash use it too: `load_dflash_model` applies `quantized_lm_head_copy` the same way `load_eagle_model` does. The target still verifies with its own head, so greedy outputs are unchanged and only the acceptance length can move.
The draft's `lm_head` is large when the vocabulary is large. With Qwen3.6-35B-A3B + DFlash2 (248k vocab) on CPU, it takes about 6 ms of a ~120 ms speculative step. On Xeon without AMX-FP8, `"fp8"` selects `CPUFp8ChannelWiseScaledMMLinearKernel` (AMX, FP8 weights, BF16 activations), which streams half the bytes.

**Test Plan**
- New `dflash-fp8-lm-head` case in `test_v2_speculator_smoke` (`tests/v1/e2e/test_cpu_spec_decode.py`).
- E2E on Xeon 6985P-C (24 cores, 23 OMP threads): Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B bf16 with incoai/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash2 and `num_speculative_tokens=7`. HumanEval, concurrency 1, 20 prompts, 128 output tokens, temperature 0. Runs interleaved bf16/fp8/bf16/fp8.

**Test Result**
`pytest tests/v1/e2e/test_cpu_spec_decode.py -k dflash`: 2 passed.

| Draft lm_head | Median ITL (ms) | Mean TPOT (ms) | Acceptance length |
|---|---|---|---|
| bf16 | 128.81 / 128.27 / 128.39 | 23.42 / 23.29 / 23.33 | 5.58 / 5.60 / 5.58 |
| fp8 | 126.65 / 126.58 / 126.60 | 23.17 / 23.16 / 23.17 | 5.55 / 5.55 / 5.55 |

🚀

This pull request has merge conflicts that must be resolved before it can be
merged. Please rebase the PR, @ekintel.

https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/working-with-forks/syncing-a-fork

Read through this. The refactor onto `share_target_lm_head` keeps the old
DFlash sharing condition, and the option reaches the right subclasses:
DFlash2 inherits it (its candidate top-k also goes through the quantized
head, which your DFlash2 AL numbers cover), XPress overrides
`supported_options`, and opting LiLiCorr out is needed since it reinstalls
the target head and requires a `VocabParallelEmbedding`.
`refresh_quantized_lm_heads` in the MRV2 runner covers the DFlash draft too.

Since the new case only runs in the CPU suite, I checked the CUDA path on
1x H200: Qwen/Qwen3-8B + z-lab/Qwen3-8B-DFlash-b16, MRV2,
num_speculative_tokens=15, max_num_seqs=1, greedy, first 64 GSM8K test
questions (chat, no thinking), max_tokens=256, runs interleaved. The fp8
copy picks `CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel`.

| Draft lm_head | Acceptance length | ms / output token (wall) |
|---|---|---|
| bf16 | 5.790 / 5.790 | 1.198 / 1.197 |
| fp8  | 5.759 / 5.759 | 1.178 / 1.172 |

Greedy outputs are identical across all four runs (64/64), as expected
with the target verifying with its own head. LGTM.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Hi @ekintel, LGTM. Adding the GB10 side to @gordan12's H200 check: DGX Spark, nightly `40941f2c4` with this PR applied, 8 greedy chat prompts at 256 tokens.

| Target + drafter | Run | AL | Outputs vs stock |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RedHatAI/Muse-Glimmer-30B-FP8-block` + `meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B-assistant` (DFlash, k=15) | stock | 4.16 | |
| | this PR | 4.16 | 8/8 identical |
| | this PR, `fp8` | 4.24 | 8/8 identical |
| `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB` + `-LiLiCorr` (k=7) | this PR | 5.04 | stock is 4.83 to 5.06 over three runs |
| | this PR, `fp8` | rejected at config | |

Bolt is not bit-reproducible run to run (two stock runs match on 1 of 8 outputs), so for it I compared AL only.

files.patch:
@@ -532,11 +532,12 @@ class SpeculativeConfig:
     sharing a KV store and external consumers of KV cache events must use the
     same setting."""
     draft_lm_head_quantization: Literal["fp8", "nvfp4"] | None = None
-    """Quantize the drafter's copy of a target lm_head it shares (EAGLE, MTP
-    and DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 DSpark). "fp8" uses per-row weight and per-token
-    activation scales on the platform's FP8 linear kernel; "nvfp4" is
-    weight-only on the platform's W4A16 kernel. The target verifies with its
-    own head, so only the acceptance length can change. Model Runner V2 only."""
+    """Quantize the drafter's copy of a target lm_head it shares (EAGLE, MTP,
+    DFlash and DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 DSpark). "fp8" uses per-row weight and
+    per-token activation scales on the platform's FP8 linear kernel; "nvfp4"
+    is weight-only on the platform's W4A16 kernel. The target verifies with
+    its own head, so only the acceptance length can change. Model Runner V2
+    only."""
     use_local_argmax_reduction: bool = False
     """Use vocab-parallel local argmax instead of all-gathering full logits
     for draft token generation. Reduces communication from O(vocab_size) to

@@ -2,7 +2,10 @@
 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
 
-from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.config import wrap_eagle_hf_config
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.config import (
+    check_draft_lm_head_quantization,
+    wrap_eagle_hf_config,
+)
 from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.speculator_config import (
     DraftModelSpeculatorConfig,
 )
@@ -16,6 +19,7 @@ class DFlashSpeculatorConfig(DraftModelSpeculatorConfig):
     speculator_class = (
         "vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dflash.speculator.DFlashSpeculator"
     )
+    supported_options = frozenset({"draft_lm_head_quantization"})
     uses_target_hidden_states = True
     supports_watermarking = True
 
@@ -29,6 +33,10 @@ def adapt_draft_model_config(cls, spec: "SpeculativeConfig") -> None:
         wrap_eagle_hf_config(spec, cls.base_method)
         spec.parallel_drafting = True
 
+    @classmethod
+    def apply_options(cls, spec: "SpeculativeConfig") -> None:
+        check_draft_lm_head_quantization(spec)
+
     @property
     def uses_aux_hidden_states(self) -> bool:
         return True

@@ -6,9 +6,9 @@
 from vllm.model_executor.model_loader import get_model
 from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import get_draft_load_config
 from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.utils import (
-    _should_share,
     get_target_lm_head,
     maybe_share_target_embed,
+    share_target_lm_head,
 )
 from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.utils import get_pp_safe_draft_load_config
 
@@ -59,17 +59,11 @@ def load_dflash_model(target_model: nn.Module, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> nn.Mo
 
     maybe_share_target_embed(dflash_model, draft_inner, target_inner)
 
-    target_lm_head = get_target_lm_head(target_model, target_language_model)
-    draft_lm_head = getattr(dflash_model, "lm_head", None)
-    if (
-        target_lm_head is not None
-        and not getattr(dflash_model.config, "has_own_lm_head", False)
-        and _should_share(
-            dflash_model, "has_own_lm_head", draft_lm_head, target_lm_head
-        )
-    ):
-        if draft_lm_head is not None:
-            del dflash_model.lm_head
-        dflash_model.lm_head = target_lm_head
+    share_target_lm_head(
+        dflash_model,
+        get_target_lm_head(target_model, target_language_model),
+        speculative_config.draft_lm_head_quantization,
+        can_share=not getattr(dflash_model.config, "has_own_lm_head", False),
+    )
 
     return dflash_model

@@ -9,3 +9,5 @@ class LiLiCorrSpeculatorConfig(DFlashSpeculatorConfig):
     )
     # Draft-side watermarking doesn't cover candidate-head drafting yet.
     supports_watermarking = False
+    # The speculator reinstalls the unquantized target lm_head for candidates.
+    supported_options = frozenset()
